title: Automotive Glass & Windshield Endorsement
citation: Illustrative Motor Comprehensive Policy — Section 2 (Endorsements), Clause G-1
text: The policy covers accidental breakage, shattering, or cracking of the front windshield, rear glass, or side windows. Certified replacement of automotive safety glass and necessary recalibration of forward-facing ADAS camera/radar sensors bonded to the glass shall be indemnified without applying the collision deductible, up to the stated glass cover limit.
